zh: 这个库已经过时了，五年没更新过。
en: This library is {outdated|out of date|obsolete}; it hasn't been updated in five years.

zh: 新版本比上一个版本稳定得多。
en: The new release is much more {stable|reliable} than the last one.

zh: 这个连接不安全，别输入你的密码。
en: This connection is not {secure|safe}; don't enter your password.

zh: 这个应用和旧手机不兼容。
en: This app isn't {compatible} with older phones.

zh: 今天的无线网真的很慢。
en: The Wi-Fi is really {slow} today.

zh: 我觉得这根线有故障，换一根试试。
en: I think this cable is {faulty|defective|broken}; try another one.

zh: 我买了一个无线鼠标，这样桌上的线少一些。
en: I bought a {wireless|cordless} mouse so there are fewer cables on my desk.

zh: 备份是自动的，你什么都不用做。
en: The backup is {automatic|automated}; you don't need to do anything.

zh: 这仍然是一个手动的流程，所以要花好几个小时。
en: It's still a {manual} process, so it takes hours.

zh: 你安装最新的版本了吗？
en: Have you installed the {latest|newest} version?

zh: 这个文件损坏了，我打不开。
en: The file is {corrupted|corrupt}, so I can't open it.

zh: 新界面好用多了，对用户更友好。
en: The new interface is much more {user-friendly|intuitive}.

zh: 这个网站响应不够快，每点一下都要等两秒。
en: The site isn't very {responsive|fast|quick}; every click takes two seconds.

zh: 目前的设计不具备可扩展性，撑不住十倍的流量。
en: The current design isn't {scalable}; it won't cope with ten times the traffic.

zh: 我的手机没电了，能借一下你的充电器吗？
en: My phone is {flat|dead}; can I borrow your charger?

zh: 服务器从今天早上起就一直离线。
en: The server has been {offline|down} since this morning.

zh: 这个设置对大多数用户来说太复杂了。
en: The setup is too {complicated|complex} for most users.

zh: 你有备用的显示器可以借我吗？
en: Do you have a {spare} monitor I could borrow?

zh: 新笔记本电脑比我的旧电脑快得多。
en: The new laptop is much {faster|quicker} than my old one.

zh: 不要把敏感数据发到公开频道里。
en: Don't put {sensitive|confidential|private} data in a public channel.
